name: 04-two-actions-custom-rule
description: A task with two outward actions and a custom rule at "before anything goes out" scoped to publishing. The owner adds the rule; the review passes while the builder already holds a second task; the custom gate passes for the publish action and does not apply to the send action; the orchestrator approves both; the builder is busy, so the task waits in Finishing, and the builder's submit of its other task gives it the action lease with action.lease_granted.
covers: PRD Quality requirements, test 8: one trace has two outward actions and one custom rule at before anything goes out.
PRD Custom rules: a custom rule is a model-checked gate; at action.requested gate rules run first and the approval policy only after every gate passed or did not apply (PRD Outward actions, step 2).
PRD How a transition is gated, step 3: a rule whose scope does not cover the action gets a not_applicable row and nothing else.

PRD Outward actions, step 3, and plan SM-8 (P-1): the builder holds something else when the approvals complete, so action.approved carries no lease; the submit that frees it writes action.lease_granted on the waiting task.

PRD Steps and timing: action.lease_granted keeps wait_builder open; a new finish row opens for the second action when the first is reported done; check keeps the first waiting action in contract order as subject (plan SM-27).
